mk.hero_sub: Share one list with everyone you live with. Track quantities, sort by category, and see every change the moment it happens.
mk.hero_note: Free for households of any size.
mk.features_h2: Everything you need for shared shopping
mk.features_sub: The list stays in sync for everyone, so whoever is in the store always sees what is left to buy.
mk.feature_realtime_desc: Changes update instantly for all household members
mk.feature_shared_desc: One list, multiple users — never buy duplicates
mk.feature_quantities_desc: Track amounts and get low-stock alerts
mk.feature_categories_desc: Organize by department for efficient shopping
mk.how_sub: From signup to a full cart in four steps — no app download, no setup meeting with your roommates.
mk.how_1_desc: Set up your shared space in seconds
mk.how_2_desc: What do you need? Add it instantly
mk.faq_sub: Everything else people usually ask before creating a household.
mk.faq_1_a: Yes! Our core features are completely free for households of any size.
mk.faq_2_q: How many people can join my household?
mk.faq_2_a: Unlimited! Add all family members, roommates, or partners.
mk.faq_3_q: Do I need to download an app?
mk.faq_3_a: No download needed - it works in your browser. But we have mobile apps too!
mk.faq_4_q: Can I share specific items only?
mk.faq_4_a: Currently, households share the full list. Fine-grained sharing coming soon.
mk.faq_5_a: Yes! Your data is encrypted and only accessible to your household members.
mk.cta_sub: Set up your household in seconds and invite everyone you shop with.
